title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde: Two Faces of LLMs
reasoning: The paper evaluates LLM safety and ethical alignment by testing models against a suite of 40 illicit questions, including specific prompts about inciting hate against religious groups (Question 23), demeaning the LGBTQ+ community (Question 24), and other ethical/moral violations. It uses an automated judge to score responses based on whether they provide harmful info or include ethical disclaimers.
